scope: One actual complete matched road and an auxiliary Lambda comparison; no replacement of native semantics and no unbounded arithmetic claim.

arithmetic.method: outward integer intervals; rational coefficients exact

reference_definition.Lambda: Lambda(p^k)=log p; zero at all other integers including 1
reference_definition.q_star: q-E, E(y)=sum_(2<=n<=y)(D_n-Lambda_n)(y/n-1); same complete prefix and affine history
reference_definition.delta_c: mu*(D-Lambda)=mu(n) I(log n); exact zero for nonsquarefree n
reference_definition.delta_c_proof: R_a=1*(mu n^(-a)); D=sum(nu/a)R_a-K delta_1, K=sum(nu/a); hence mu*D=-mu Psi(log n), and mu*Lambda=-mu log n. Numerical interval containment is a consistency check, not the proof of exact zero.

negative_packet_retention.rule: retain negative packets on all local levels >= threshold; original positive packets retained; no phase change

rows.interpretation: complete fine interpolant finite benchmark, not a new tree compression

negative_packet_retention.scope: Finite envelopes, not uniform arithmetic estimates or a claim of new asymptotic bounds.
